title: Scanner
shipSub: Parcel handed to the driver or the courier
then: Then scan with the barcode gun, or type the tracking number and press Enter.
thenPhone: Then the camera opens to scan the barcode.

dispatch.title: Scan the parcels to dispatch
dispatch.help: Scan each parcel when you hand it to the driver or the courier. If it is good, it becomes “Shipped” right away.

back.title: Return / Exchange
back.help: Scan each parcel back at the depot. A return becomes “Returned” and stock is put back; an exchange puts the old product back in stock.

inputPh: Scan the tracking no. or the ref. PX…
idlePc: PC: click once in the box then scan with the barcode gun. Phone: Camera button, sharp photo of the barcode.
idlePhone: Tap Camera for each parcel: sharp photo of the barcode. The phone asks for permission the first time.
postEmpty: Each scanned parcel shows here with its result.
noBarcode: No barcode found on the photo.
noBarcodeFix: Hold the phone 15–20 cm away, barcode straight, no glare. Or type the number.
refusedFix: Try again. If it keeps happening, open the order to see the problem.
camHelp: Put the barcode in the frame, straight and without glare.
camDenied: Camera unavailable or refused. Use “Photo” instead.

test.title: Test parcels
test.help: Demo only. Choose “Ship” or “Return / Exchange” above (column “Choose”), then copy a code, paste it in the scanner box and press Enter. Wait 3 seconds before scanning the same code again. After a “Good”, the parcel changed status: scanning it again shows the double scan. “Reset” recreates all test parcels.
